# places-fixture.sqlite

A realistic-but-entirely-synthetic Firefox Places database for testing the
harness against non-trivial history data (dashboards, search, snapshot
performance) without using anyone's real browsing data.

**Provenance:** generated by
`tests/browser/browser_places_fixture.js` from embedded lists of public
information (Wikipedia article titles, public GitHub repos, MDN paths,
generic search queries, synthetic news slugs) and a seeded PRNG. No real
profile data is involved; regenerating with the same seed reproduces the
same content. Inserts go through `PlacesUtils.history` /
`PlacesUtils.bookmarks`, so guids, `url_hash`, frecency and `moz_origins`
are computed by the real Places code and the file is a drop-in
`places.sqlite`.

Contents (seed 20260728): ~5,950 pages, ~23,000 visits spanning one year
(weekday/diurnal-weighted sessions, referrer chains, typed/link/reload
transition mix), 31 bookmarks, ~4.9 MB.

Regenerate:

```
MOZ_GENERATE_PLACES_FIXTURE=$PWD/browser/components/harness/tests/fixtures/places-fixture.sqlite \
  ./mach mochitest --headless browser/components/harness/tests/browser/browser_places_fixture.js
```

Uses: copy over a test profile's `places.sqlite` (profile closed), or drop
into a harness workspace as `/workspace/places.sqlite` for guest-side
queries.
